<!-- Description: Shared worker skill — claim, analyze, implement, test, commit, close a single bead on a supervisor-owned branch. The TRD supervisor owns branches and PRs; this worker executes on the given branch. -->

# ensemble:implement-bead-worker

> **Mission:** Shared worker that executes a single bead on a pre-created branch owned by the invoking supervisor. Receives BEAD_ID and (optionally) BRANCH_NAME from the supervisor. Performs: claim -> analyze -> implement -> test -> commit -> close. Does NOT create branches or PRs — those belong to the supervisor. State transitions are recorded via br comments for cross-session visibility. Returns a structured completion summary to the supervisor. This is an internal worker skill. It is invoked by implement-bead (both standalone and orchestrated modes — implement-bead sets up the branch before invoking the worker) and by implement-trd-beads (TRD supervisor). Do not invoke directly from the chat prompt — use /ensemble:implement-bead-worker only for supervisor orchestration.

## Phase 1: Preflight

### Step 1: Argument Parsing

Extract bead ID and optional branch name from arguments

**Actions:**
1. Parse $ARGUMENTS: extract first token as BEAD_ID (e.g., "beads-042" or "42"); if numeric only, leave as-is — br accepts bare integers
2. If --synthetic <kind> is present in $ARGUMENTS: store SYNTHETIC_KIND=<kind> (must be one of: ac-validation, cross-cutting, none; reject and HALT if any other value)
3. If --synthetic is absent: store SYNTHETIC_KIND="" (empty sentinel — title inference happens in Bead Validation after BEAD_TITLE is populated)
4. If --branch <name> is present in $ARGUMENTS: store as ORCHESTRATED_BRANCH; else ORCHESTRATED_BRANCH = ""
5. If --branch was supplied: verify current branch matches ORCHESTRATED_BRANCH before proceeding
6. Run: git branch --show-current
7. If $? != 0 or output is empty: print "WARNING: Detached HEAD — commit will land on current ref (<hash>). Bead: <BEAD_ID>."; set VERIFIED_BRANCH="<detached>"
8. If output != ORCHESTRATED_BRANCH: print "ERROR: Branch mismatch. Supplied --branch=<ORCHESTRATED_BRANCH> but current branch is <current>. Will NOT proceed to prevent committing to wrong branch." and EXIT
9. If output == ORCHESTRATED_BRANCH: set VERIFIED_BRANCH=<ORCHESTRATED_BRANCH>; print "Branch verified: <VERIFIED_BRANCH>"
10. If --branch was NOT supplied (standalone mode): run: git branch --show-current; if output is empty (detached HEAD): print "ERROR: Cannot run worker in detached HEAD state without --branch. Switch to a branch first." and EXIT; set VERIFIED_BRANCH to the current branch; print "Using current branch: <VERIFIED_BRANCH>"

### Step 2: Tool Availability Check

Verify br is installed and functional

**Actions:**
1. "which br || { echo 'ERROR: br (beads_rust) not installed.'; exit 1; }"
2. "br list --status=open > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'ERROR: br not functional.'; exit 1; }"

### Step 3: Bead Validation

Fetch bead details and verify it is actionable

**Actions:**
1. Run: br show <BEAD_ID> — if exit code != 0 print "ERROR: Bead <BEAD_ID> not found." and EXIT
2. Parse bead fields: store BEAD_TITLE, BEAD_STATUS, BEAD_TYPE, BEAD_DESCRIPTION
3. If BEAD_STATUS == "closed": print "Bead <BEAD_ID> is already closed." and EXIT
4. Print: "Bead: <BEAD_ID> | Status: <BEAD_STATUS> | Type: <BEAD_TYPE> | Title: <BEAD_TITLE>"
5. Derive TITLE_SYNTHETIC_KIND: match BEAD_TITLE against /\[trd:[^\]]+:task:(AC-\d+(?:-\d+|[A-Z])?)\]/i — if captured AC_ID non-empty: TITLE_SYNTHETIC_KIND=ac-validation; else match /\[trd:[^\]]+:task:(XC-[A-Z0-9]+(?:-[A-Z0-9]+)*)\]/i — if captured XC_ID non-empty: TITLE_SYNTHETIC_KIND=cross-cutting; else TITLE_SYNTHETIC_KIND=none
6. If SYNTHETIC_KIND != "" AND SYNTHETIC_KIND != TITLE_SYNTHETIC_KIND: print "ERROR: --synthetic flag (<SYNTHETIC_KIND>) conflicts with title-derived kind (<TITLE_SYNTHETIC_KIND>). Will not proceed." and HALT before any validation
7. If SYNTHETIC_KIND == "": SYNTHETIC_KIND=TITLE_SYNTHETIC_KIND  (no flag — adopt title inference)
8. If SYNTHETIC_KIND == "ac-validation" and no AC_ID captured from title: print "ERROR: --synthetic ac-validation but no AC ID in bead title. Cannot emit ac-validation token." and HALT
9. If SYNTHETIC_KIND == "cross-cutting" and no XC_ID captured from title: print "ERROR: --synthetic cross-cutting but no XC ID in bead title. Cannot emit xc-validation token." and HALT

## Phase 2: Analyse

### Step 1: Mark In-Progress

Transition bead to in_progress state and record agent comment

**Actions:**
1. Run: br update <BEAD_ID> --status=in_progress
2. Run: br comment add <BEAD_ID> "status:in_progress agent:implement-bead-worker branch:<VERIFIED_BRANCH>"

### Step 2: Codebase Analysis

Read bead description and search codebase for relevant files

**Actions:**
1. Read full bead description and any existing comments via br show <BEAD_ID>
2. Extract keywords from BEAD_TITLE and BEAD_DESCRIPTION (nouns, domain terms, file hints)
3. Search codebase with Grep and Glob using extracted keywords to locate relevant source files, test files, and configuration
4. Identify framework and language from package.json, mix.exs, Gemfile, or *.csproj as applicable
5. Identify related test files matching the source files found
6. Print an implementation plan: files to modify, approach, test strategy, and any edge cases
7. Record WORKER_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN with: relevant_files, approach, test_strategy

## Phase 3: Implement

### Step 1: Specialist Delegation

Delegate implementation to the appropriate specialist agent

**Actions:**
1. Select appropriate specialist by keyword matching against BEAD_TITLE and BEAD_DESCRIPTION:
2. backend/api/endpoint/database/server/model/migration -> @backend-developer
3. frontend/ui/component/react/vue/angular/svelte/css -> @frontend-developer
4. infra/deploy/docker/k8s/kubernetes/aws/cloud/terraform -> @infrastructure-developer
5. architecture/design/system/multi-component/cross-cutting -> @tech-lead-orchestrator
6. test/spec/e2e/playwright/coverage -> @test-runner or @playwright-tester
7. docs/readme/documentation/changelog/api-docs -> @documentation-specialist
8. default -> @backend-developer
9. Check .claude/router-rules.json first; project-specific agents take priority over keyword defaults
10. Delegate via Task(subagent_type=<specialist>, prompt="Implement bead <BEAD_ID>: <BEAD_TITLE>. Description: <BEAD_DESCRIPTION>. Target files: <WORKER_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.relevant_files>. Approach: <WORKER_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.approach>. When done provide a structured summary: files changed, what was implemented, any issues encountered.")

### Step 2: Test Validation

Run relevant tests and fix failures before proceeding

**Actions:**
1. Detect test framework from package.json, mix.exs, Gemfile, or *.csproj
2. Run test suite (npm test, mix test, bundle exec rspec, dotnet test, or detected equivalent)
3. If tests fail: analyse failure output, attempt targeted fixes, re-run tests (max 2 attempts)
4. If tests still fail after 2 attempts: Record TEST_RESULT={ passed: false, attempts: 3, framework: <detected> }; print "WORKER_COMPLETE: bead=<BEAD_ID> test-passed=false test-attempts=3 test-framework=<detected> branch=<VERIFIED_BRANCH> commit-sha=none files-changed=uncommitted validation=test-failed:exhausted-retries commit=none"; print "TEST_FAILURE: test-passed=false bead=<BEAD_ID> — resetting to open, supervisor will handle."; Run: br update <BEAD_ID> --status=open; Run: br comment add <BEAD_ID> "status:open test-failed:exhausted-retries attempts=3 agent:implement-bead-worker"; Run: br sync --flush-only; HALT — do NOT close bead, do NOT amend, do NOT continue to Validate or Complete
5. If tests pass (first attempt or after retry): Record TEST_RESULT={ passed: true, attempts: <actual>, framework: <detected> }  — must be recorded before Validate phase interpolates TEST_RESULT.passed/attempts/framework

## Phase 4: Validate

### Step 1: Synthetic Validation

For AC-* and XC-* beads, run structured evidence checks and write validation tokens

**Actions:**
1. Record WORKER_TRACKED=$(git diff --name-only HEAD | tr "\n" " ")
2. Record WORKER_UNTRACKED=$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard | tr "\n" " ")
3. Record WORKER_FILES_CHANGED=$(echo "$WORKER_TRACKED $WORKER_UNTRACKED" | tr -s " ")
4. If SYNTHETIC_KIND == "ac-validation":
5. Extract AC_ID from BEAD_TITLE using case-insensitive regex /\[trd:[^\]]+:task:(AC-\d+(?:-\d+|[A-Z])?)\]/i (e.g. AC-001, AC-002-1, AC-013A — anchored to scaffold task segment to avoid AC IDs mentioned in task descriptions)
6. Detect implementation artifacts:
7. code_source: "changed" if WORKER_TRACKED contains source file (.ts/.js/.py/.ex/.rb/.cs/etc.); "new" if WORKER_UNTRACKED contains source file; "none" if neither
8. code_exists: true if code_source!=none OR any source file matching patterns from BEAD_DESCRIPTION exists in repo (AC tasks verify existing implementation — search full repo for referenced files/patterns, not just uncommitted diff)
9. Detect test artifacts from WORKER_FILES_CHANGED and package files:
10. test_command: inferred from package.json (jest, playwright), mix.exs (exunit), Gemfile (rspec), *.csproj (xunit)
11. test_framework: detected framework name
12. test_attempts: <TEST_RESULT.attempts>
13. test_passed: <TEST_RESULT.passed>
14. test_exists: true if test files found in WORKER_FILES_CHANGED or test_command available
15. Run integration test check if INTEGRATION_TEST_PATHS env var or project config has known integration test commands; record integration_passed: true/false/na
16. Determine verdict:
17. If code_exists==true AND test_exists==true AND test_passed==true AND integration_passed!=false: verdict=proven
18. Else: verdict=not_proven
19. Record CODE_EVIDENCE=<code_source> if code_source!=none else "existing"
20. Run: br comment add <BEAD_ID> "ac-validation:<AC_ID> code:<CODE_EVIDENCE> tests:<test_passed|fail|missing|disabled> integration:<integration_passed|na> verdict:<verdict> evidence:<test_command> <test_framework>"
21. Record VALIDATION_RESULT=ac-validation:<AC_ID>:verdict:<verdict>
22. Else if SYNTHETIC_KIND == "cross-cutting":
23. Extract XC_ID from BEAD_TITLE using case-insensitive regex /\[trd:[^\]]+:task:(XC-[A-Z0-9]+(?:-[A-Z0-9]+)*)\]/i — anchored to scaffold task segment to avoid XC IDs mentioned in task descriptions
24. Require WORKER_FILES_CHANGED to contain at least one source file in a named XC domain (e.g. src/hooks/, src/services/, src/middleware/, src/shared/); if no relevant files changed: verdict=not_proven (vacuous pass not allowed)
25. If files present: identify affected domains and check each for cross-cutting pattern violations: shared mutable state, tight coupling across domain boundaries, missing abstraction layers
26. Determine verdict: verdict=proven only if relevant files exist AND no violations found; verdict=not_proven otherwise
27. Run: br comment add <BEAD_ID> "xc-validation:<XC_ID> domains:<comma-joined-domains> verdict:<verdict> evidence:<files-list>"
28. Record VALIDATION_RESULT=xc-validation:<XC_ID>:verdict:<verdict>
29. Else:
30. Record VALIDATION_RESULT=none
31. Print: VALIDATION_TOKEN: <VALIDATION_RESULT>

## Phase 5: Complete

### Step 1: Commit Changes

Stage and commit changes on the supervisor-owned branch

**Actions:**
1. Run: br sync --flush-only  (persist any pending comments — validation tasks may have no product-file changes; the beads export is the authoritative record)
2. Run: git status to review changed files
3. Stage the Beads export: git add .beads/beads.jsonl (br sync may have modified it)
4. Stage product changed files: git add <list from git status — never use git add . or git add -A>
5. Generate commit message using conventional commit format: "feat: <BEAD_TITLE> [bead:<BEAD_ID>]" or "fix: <BEAD_TITLE> [bead:<BEAD_ID>]" depending on bead type
6. Run: git commit -m "<message>"
7. Record WORKER_COMMIT=<message>
8. Record WORKER_FILES_CHANGED=$(git show --pretty= --name-only HEAD | tr "\n" " ")
9. Record WORKER_COMMIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)  (captured here — before HALT path in step 2; refreshed after --amend in step 2 on success)

### Step 2: Close Bead

Transition bead to closed state and record completion comment

**Actions:**
1. If SYNTHETIC_KIND in ("ac-validation","cross-cutting") AND VALIDATION_RESULT contains "verdict:not_proven": Run: br update <BEAD_ID> --status=open; Run: br comment add <BEAD_ID> "verdict:not_proven — <SYNTHETIC_KIND> failed in implement-bead-worker, reset to open"; Run: br sync --flush-only; git add .beads/beads.jsonl; git commit --amend --no-edit; Record WORKER_COMMIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD); print "WORKER_COMPLETE: bead=<BEAD_ID> test-passed=<TEST_RESULT.passed> test-attempts=<TEST_RESULT.attempts> test-framework=<TEST_RESULT.framework> branch=<VERIFIED_BRANCH> commit-sha=<WORKER_COMMIT_SHA> files-changed=<WORKER_FILES_CHANGED> validation=<VALIDATION_RESULT> commit=<WORKER_COMMIT>"; print "HALT: Synthetic bead <BEAD_ID> verdict not_proven — bead reset to open (worker self-reset; idempotent for TRD audit). Supervisor will handle." and HALT; do NOT run br close or write status:closed
2. Run: br close <BEAD_ID> --reason="Completed [bead:<BEAD_ID> branch:<VERIFIED_BRANCH> test:<TEST_RESULT.passed>]"
3. Run: br comment add <BEAD_ID> "status:closed agent:implement-bead-worker branch:<VERIFIED_BRANCH> test:<TEST_RESULT.passed> commit:<WORKER_COMMIT>"
4. Run: br sync --flush-only
5. Stage the Beads export: git add .beads/beads.jsonl (or whichever file br sync modified)
6. Amend to embed bead metadata: git commit --amend --no-edit
7. Record WORKER_COMMIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)

### Step 3: Worker Completion Summary

Return structured completion data to the supervisor

**Actions:**
1. Print worker completion block:
2. WORKER_COMPLETE:
3. bead=<BEAD_ID>
4. test-passed=<TEST_RESULT.passed>
5. test-attempts=<TEST_RESULT.attempts>
6. test-framework=<TEST_RESULT.framework>
7. branch=<VERIFIED_BRANCH>
8. commit-sha=<WORKER_COMMIT_SHA>
9. files-changed=<WORKER_FILES_CHANGED>
10. validation=<VALIDATION_RESULT>
11. commit=<WORKER_COMMIT>
12. This worker does NOT create PRs. Supervisor (TRD lead) is responsible for PR creation.
